summary: Gate hooks and taps reach a `tool` by edge in place of their `binary` strings; the default is the temper package's bin at the anchored `.bin` path
acceptance: a gate hook and a tap render the command of the tool they point at; with none declared they run the temper package bin's anchored `.bin` path; an unrepresented harness still runs `temper` on the PATH
tests: a gate hook runs the command of the tool it reaches
a tap runs the command of its declaration's tool
a gate hook declaring no tool runs the temper package bin's anchored path
pins: an unrepresented harness's gate hook runs temper on the path
notes: 0104 consequence: the three `binary` fields lower onto tool members (rg `binary` across sdk/src and src/; GATE_BINARY_KEY, TAP_BINARY_KEY retire). Breaking SDK change: the dogfood `.temper/` (human territory) adapts after it ships — say so in the commit body.
